stories.event: On 3 Nov Kremlin spokesman Peskov said trilateral talks with Ukraine and the US would be held in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday and Wednesday, 10-11 Nov, the first since February; US envoy Witkoff said Washington would mediate, and a senior US official said Witkoff and Kushner were expected to attend. On 7 Nov the Kremlin named Russia's delegation: Medinsky, deputy foreign ministers Ryabkov and Galuzin, GRU chief Kostyukov and General Staff officer Zhigarlovsky; they met Putin on 6 Nov. Ukraine's delegation is led by Rustem Umerov, with Arakhamia, Budanov and Kyslytsia (Arakhamia, 6 Nov). On 8 Nov French foreign minister Barrot said France would take part in Abu Dhabi. Russia's strikes on Ukraine continued, with over 3,000 drones in the week to 8 Nov according to Zelensky.

stories.event: Bank ueno was placed in resolution at the start of November and the BCP began paying the Deposit Guarantee Fund advance on 5 November. President Santiago Peña announced his resignation on 5 November but then chose to face impeachment; on 6 November the Senate removed him by 44 votes and Pedro Alliana was sworn in. On 7 November a judge ordered preventive custody for Peña and for ex-BCP head Carlos Carvallo and froze their assets. By 7-8 November the BCP had credited about 1.2 million of 1.87 million accounts with a balance, in two groups without debts. The BCP said a new stage for depositors with debts would start on 9 November and that held-back accounts (blocks, several accounts) would be paid on Monday and on Tuesday at the latest; the legal window for the advance ends on 11 November.
